info.name: ApnaFund API Collection
info.description: Saari mobile/web APIs. **Root JSON:** legacy `*.php` responses are **objects** (`ResponseCode`, `Result`, `ResponseMsg`, …); arrays live under keys like `faqs`, `updates`, `comments`. POST bodies: `Content-Type: application/json` + raw JSON where noted. Multipart: folders `1m` / `2m`. **Modules:** `Campaign — detail, FAQ, updates, comments (web)…` (root: detail + FAQ/update **get**; subfolders **Update page — comments**, **Campaign page — comments**), `Public APIs`, `Protected APIs (Bearer)`, `Admin APIs`, `IPN Webhooks`.

item.name: Campaign — detail, FAQ, updates, comments (web), story, collaborators, payment
item.description: **Pehle read APIs (root):** campaign detail (GET), FAQ get, backer updates get. **Phir web (session + CSRF):** `Update page — comments` (list/get JSON + submit), `Campaign page — comments` (list fetch + submit). **Neeche:** protected fund lists, story, collaborators, payment; FAQ/update **mutations** (Bearer). Legacy `*.php` root = JSON **object** (`ResponseCode`, `faqs`, `updates`, …).

item.name: 1. Campaign detail (GET /api/campaigns)
item.description: List, featured, single campaign by `{{campaign_slug}}`. Har item mein **kitni funding mili**: `raised_amount` (goal ke mutabiq), `goal_amount`, `progress_percentage`, `donors_count`. Response root par `meta.currency` + `meta.currency_symbol` (site currency). Cookie zaroori nahi — sirf `Accept: application/json`.

item.name: 2. FAQ — get (public, campaign_faq.php)
item.description: Bina Bearer: GET ya legacy POST `op=list|get`. Mutations alag folder.

body.raw:
{
  "op": "create",
  "campaign_id": "{{campaign_id}}",

  "order": 1
}

item.name: 4. Backer updates — get (public, campaign_post_updates.php)
item.description: GET `op=list|get`; legacy POST + Bearer editor ke liye.

formdata.value: We reached 50% funding — thank you everyone for supporting this campaign!
Updated content at least thirty characters long here.

item.name: 6. Update page — comments (web + API)
item.description: **GET** JSON page: `?format=json` — `comments`, `update`, `campaign`. **Web POST** `/updates/{id}/comment`: session + CSRF + login. **API POST** `/api/campaign_update_comment.php`: **Bearer only** (no CSRF); body `slug` or `campaign_id`, `update_id`, `comment`; `user_id` token se.

item.name: GET — update + `comments` JSON (`?format=json` or Accept: application/json)
7. Campaign page — comments (web)
item.description: Campaign **main page** comments: `fetch-comment` = list; `POST .../comment` = submit (guest fields). CSRF zaroori.

item.name: POST my_donate_fundlist.php — campaigns I donated to
Protected — People / collaborators (campaign_collaborators.php)
item.description: Web: `/user/campaign/edit/{slug}/people` — user search (add se pehle), collaborators list, add, remove. **Bearer** (Sanctum). Add/remove sirf **campaign owner**; list owner + collaborators. Campaign: `campaign_id` | `fund_id` | `slug`.

item.name: GET — search users (op=search, q min 2 chars)
Protected — Payment / payout banks (campaign_payment.php)
item.description: Web: `/user/campaign/edit/{slug}/payment` — `payout_banks[]` (active) + `campaign_payment` (saved bank + account). **op=save** sirf **campaign owner**; list dekh sakte hain owner + collaborators.

item.name: GET — payout banks + current campaign payment (op=list)
POST — save payout bank + account (op=save, owner only)
2b. Currency information
item.description: GET preferred. POST bhi JSON body se `currency` optional.
